welcome.sourceText: Welcome to your family storybook. Make your growing story, then follow family stars around the world.
welcome.transcript: Welcome to your family storybook. Make your growing story, then follow family stars around the world.

timeline-intro.sourceText: The memories got mixed up. Put baby, toddler, and now in order.
